# Project Governance 4.5.6

An explicit local-host cleanup can use the original native supervisor receipt for a single completed
local build, without inventing or recreating a missing duplicate wrapper closure report. Original
native identity, full membership, fresh process/group absence, exact ownership/generation and normal
reconciliation remain required. Existing successful or failed command results stay unchanged.

This selection covers declared local producer/storage reservations only. External mutexes, services,
devices and remote obligations retain their own evidence requirements. It does not automatically
release workflows, replay builds, upgrade adopter pins or establish product acceptance.

Qualification uses the normal 4.x local release path with independent Opus5.5 high review, focused
source/installed checks and exact clean-archive proof. GitHub CI is skipped. Full proof identities
and readback remain with the external release record.
